rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a postage stamp.

example.english: I bought a stamp to mail this letter.
example.traditional: 我買咗張郵票寄呢封信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 jau4 piu3 gei3 ni1 fung1 seon3

rows.note: Use this for putting an official stamp or seal on a passport, document, or form.

example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 soeng6 goi3 jan3

rows.note: Use this specifically for putting postage stamps on a letter or parcel.

example.english: Remember to stamp the letter before mailing it.
example.jyutping: gei3 seon3 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 tip3 jau4 piu3

rows.note: Use this for a physical imprint or mark left by stamping, rather than the stamping tool.

example.english: There is a stamp on the form.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 biu2 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 jan3

rows.note: Use this for repeatedly stamping your feet, especially in anger or a tantrum.

example.english: They were so angry that they started to stamp their feet.
example.jyutping: keoi5 nau1 dou3 bat1 ting4 gam3 do2 goek3

rows.note: Use this for the hand-held stamp tool used to make designs or marks.

example.english: Lend me the stamp so I can stamp this bag.
example.traditional: 借個印仔畀我印吓呢個袋啦。
example.jyutping: ze3 go3 jan3 zai2 bei2 ngo5 jan3 haa5 ni1 go3 doi6 laa1

rows.note: Use this for pressing a design or mark into a surface, especially in manufacturing.

example.english: This machine is specially used to stamp designs onto leather.
example.traditional: 呢部機專門用嚟將圖案壓印喺皮革上面。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 zyun1 mun4 jung6 lei4 zoeng1 tou4 on3 aat3 jan3 hai2 pei4 gaak3 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use this when the English item is a decorative adhesive sticker rather than an inking stamp.

example.english: I bought some stamp-themed stickers to decorate the card.
example.traditional: 我買咗啲貼紙裝飾張卡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 tip3 zi2 zong1 sik1 zoeng1 kaa1
